entries.claim: LCA-closure guards provide O(|A|) bounded-size separators for paths to landmarks in a measured bounded-treewidth graph.
entries.scope: Beaudou et al., Lemma 15; separator coverage does not itself bound guard profile diversity.

entries.claim: Outerplanar profile counting uses monotone distance partitions on root-BFS layers under a common boundary order.
entries.scope: Beaudou et al., Theorem 7; the circular order premise is not supplied for arbitrary partial-simple-3-tree corridors.

entries.claim: Linear-matroid representative families preserve all bounded-size extension-feasibility queries through exterior-algebra pairing.
entries.scope: Fomin et al., Theorems 1 and 3; no min-plus metric completion representation was established here.

entries.claim: The shortlisted CS3, matroid-transfer, corridor-order, and caterpillar-detour bridges yielded no strictly narrower defensible new lemma in this bounded cycle.
entries.scope: No candidate admitted; this does not refute the underlying simple-treewidth profile conjecture or arbitrary-tree routing conjecture.
